intro: EHN Sandstone Recovery Centre is a live-in eating disorder program for teenagers and young adults in northeast Calgary, run by EHN Canada. We listed it for years as Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre, when the same house ran an adult addiction program. In 2024 it reopened as Alberta's first residential eating disorder recovery centre, and it no longer offers addiction treatment or detox.

The centre has 12 beds and treats anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa. Care starts with medical and nutritional stabilization. From there the days fill with group therapy, supported meals and weekly individual and family sessions using DBT and CBT, and staff are on site around the clock. Alberta residents aged 12 to 24 pay nothing, because the Government of Alberta funds the beds. People aged 18 to 29, or from outside Alberta, can come through a separate self-pay program.

pillars.title: A Restored 1967 Convent in Northeast Calgary
pillars.body: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre has a rich history dating back to 1967. The facility has undergone significant renovations and has been beautifully restored to offer clients a comfortable and home-like environment. The facility is located in a quiet neighborhood in Calgary, Canada, providing a serene and peaceful setting for healing. The intimate setting offers those struggling with eating disorders and related mental health concerns a safe space for recovery. The attentive staff ensures that clients receive the highest level of care and support they need during their stay. EHN says the building went up in 1967 as a convent for the Sister Servants of Mary Immaculate. Today it has private and semi-private bedrooms and shared lounges, on a residential street a few minutes north of the Bow River.

pillars.title: Families in the Room, Then Aftercare Groups
pillars.body: Families are part of treatment from the start. There is family therapy every week, and the length of stay is reviewed at a weekly family meeting, so parents and partners can see discharge coming. Younger patients get help keeping up with school while they are here. Once an inpatient stay ends, EHN Canada runs weekly aftercare groups for up to 12 months. EHN says eligibility depends on the program and how it was funded, so ask the team what applies to you.

pillars.title: A Medical and Clinical Team on Site Around the Clock
pillars.body: Doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses, registered dietitians, counsellors and support staff cover Sandstone 24 hours a day, according to EHN. Its eating disorder team also includes psychiatrists and psychotherapists, and Red Seal chefs cook the meals. The centre came out of a long campaign by Calgary's Silver Linings Foundation, which raised $4 million toward it. The Government of Alberta committed nearly $10 million over three years to fund the beds, with support from Recovery Alberta.

overviewH2: Before 2024: Sandstone as an Adult Addiction Centre
overview: The paragraphs below come from our original listing. They describe the adult addiction program that ran in this building before it became an eating disorder centre. Detox, outpatient and addiction treatment are no longer offered at Sandstone, so read this as history and check current details with EHN Canada.

The Sandstone Impatient Treatment Centre is an inclusive and caring environment providing personalized treatment programs and a tailored approach for each patient’s needs. We offer both inpatient and outpatient programs and have a mission of making addiction recovery accessible to all. Our intensive outpatient treatment program is perfect for individuals who require consistent and structured assistance in their recovery, but still maintain responsibilities outside of treatment. The inpatient program, however, is a comprehensive program for individuals who require complete support in a distraction-free environment to facilitate their rehabilitation.

At Sandstone, our programs are designed to incorporate evidence-based treatment practices that are effective in promoting healing and recovery. Additionally, our intimate and welcoming setting, combined with our knowledgeable and compassionate medical professionals, offers a serene and calming atmosphere that supports our patients’ journey to a successful recovery. Our programs have been successful in helping many individuals struggling with addiction and we continuously strive to provide the most compassionate, tailored care possible.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre offers comprehensive treatment programs for substance use disorder, eating disorders, sex addiction, and co-occurring mental health conditions. To ensure that clients receive the right level of care, Sandstone provides a range of programs that include medical detox, intensive outpatient programs (IOPs), virtual IOPs, and residential treatment. The facility’s program combines evidence-based therapies, including cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) and dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), relapse prevention, meditation, yoga, and other holistic approaches. Clients receive one-on-one attention from caring and compassionate clinicians, ensuring that their individual needs are met.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre provides a structured daily routine that is designed to help clients develop healthy habits and promote healing. The day begins with a healthy and delicious chef-prepared breakfast, followed by time to meditate. Clients will engage in a physical fitness routine that can include gym time, walking, or attending a yoga class. After the morning exercise, clients attend a psychoeducational lecture to learn about the nature of their substance use. In the afternoon, clients will have individual counseling followed by a delicious dinner. After dinner, clients will attend a group AA, NA, or SMART panel before enjoying game night or TV time. The structured routine provides predictability and stability, helping clients focus on their recovery.

The admissions process for Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre is straightforward. Clients can either self-refer or be referred by a healthcare provider. Sandstone offers an extensive assessment to determine the client’s treatment needs and recommendations for care. The facility accepts a range of insurance options, and there is also private pay and financing available for those who need assistance. The cost of the program varies depending on the level of care, but a financial representative is available to help clients understand their options and create a plan that works for them.

Downtown Calgary is about 10 minutes away by car, Airdrie about 30 minutes, Okotoks about 40, Red Deer about 1 hour 45 minutes and Edmonton about 3 hours, and the funded beds take referrals from anywhere in Alberta.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and the EHN Canada website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: Does EHN Sandstone still treat addiction?
faqs.a: No. Since 2024 Sandstone has been an inpatient eating disorder centre, and EHN Canada no longer runs addiction treatment, detox or outpatient programs there. Earlier versions of this listing described the adult addiction program that used the building before. For addiction care in Calgary, see our Calgary listings or call our helpline.

faqs.q: How much does EHN Sandstone cost?
faqs.a: For Alberta residents aged 12 to 24 with a valid Alberta Health Care card, there is no cost, because the Government of Alberta funds the beds. People aged 18 to 29, or from outside Alberta, can apply to a separate self-pay program. EHN does not publish the self-pay price, so ask admissions for a quote.

faqs.q: How do I get a referral to Sandstone?
faqs.a: You need a referral from an Alberta physician or nurse practitioner for the funded program. Patients must have a diagnosed eating disorder, be medically stable and be willing to take part, and the family must commit to being involved. EHN Canada also has referral and admissions forms on its website.

faqs.q: What eating disorders does Sandstone treat?
faqs.a: Sandstone treats anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa, along with the problems that sit underneath them. Treatment combines nutritional rehabilitation and meal support with individual, group and family therapy, including DBT and CBT. Medication is used if needed.

faqs.q: Is there an age requirement for treatment?
faqs.a: Yes. The funded program is for ages 12 to 24, and the self-pay program is for ages 18 to 29.

faqs.q: How long does the program last?
faqs.a: The program length varies depending on the client’s treatment needs. A typical stay is 8 to 12 weeks, and someone coming straight from hospital may stay a few weeks to focus on weight restoration. Length of stay is reviewed at a weekly family meeting.

No, Sandstone does not offer addiction detox any more. Its medical work is stabilization for eating disorders: medical and nutritional stabilization, structured meal support and 24-hour care from doctors, nurse practitioners and nurses.

faqs.q: Where is EHN Sandstone and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 802 7 Ave NE in northeast Calgary, between Bridgeland and Renfrew, about 10 minutes from downtown by car. Families driving in from Airdrie take about 30 minutes, from Red Deer about 1 hour 45 minutes and from Edmonton about 3 hours. Call 1-866-938-5003 before you travel.

EHN Canada offers weekly aftercare groups for up to 12 months after inpatient treatment, and families are involved throughout the stay so they are ready for the move home. EHN says aftercare eligibility depends on the program and how it was funded, so confirm what is included before discharge.
Yes, we do allow family visits, and we also offer family therapy sessions.
